title: Telegram Bot API reference dataset (tgautodocs)
description: Machine-readable dataset derived from https://core.telegram.org/bots/api. One flat entities[] array holds three kinds of records: method, type, and topic.

entities.description: All records: documentation topics, API methods, and types, in document order of the source page.

field.description: One row of a method parameter table or a type field table.

name.description: Exact parameter/field name from the docs' first column.

type_display.description: Exact string from the docs' Type column, verbatim (e.g. "Integer", "Integer or String", "Array of MessageEntity", "True", "InputFile").

required.description: True when the docs' Required column says "Yes". Only method parameter tables have a Required column; type field tables do not, so every type field is false (optionality is expressed inline in the description, kept verbatim).

description_md.description: Verbatim description converted from HTML to markdown.

method.description: An API method that can be called, e.g. sendMessage.

id.description: CamelCase method name exactly as documented (e.g. sendMessage).

description_md.description: The method's description, verbatim, converted from HTML to markdown. Includes any post-table notes (blockquotes) belonging to the method.

fields.description: Parameter rows in table order. Empty for parameterless methods (getMe, close, logOut, ...).

returns.description: Type named in the method's "On success, ... is returned" sentence, e.g. "Message", "Array of Update", "True". Uses the docs' own type vocabulary ("True" for methods documented as returning True).

url.description: Anchor URL on the official page.

type.description: A data structure, e.g. Message, User, InlineKeyboardMarkup. Includes abstract union types and fieldless types.

id.description: CamelCase type name exactly as documented (e.g. MessageEntity).

description_md.description: The type's description, verbatim, converted from HTML to markdown. For union types this includes the subtype list.

fields.description: Field rows in table order. Empty for fieldless types (VideoChatStarted, ForumTopicClosed, ...) and for union types.

variants.description: For abstract union types ("It can be one of ..."), the ids of the concrete subtypes, in the order listed on the page. Empty for all other types.

url.description: Anchor URL on the official page.

topic.description: A documentation section (e.g. "Making requests"). Subtopics are folded into content_md, never separate records.

title.description: Section heading exactly as printed on the page (e.g. "Making requests").

content_md.description: The section's intro prose plus all folded-in subtopic prose (subtopic headings kept as ## headings), converted from HTML to markdown. Entity records are not duplicated here; they are referenced via methods[] and types[].

methods.description: Ids of the method records belonging to this section, in page order.

types.description: Ids of the type records belonging to this section, in page order.

url.description: Anchor URL on the official page.
